criterionFindings.finding: Both rolls have coherent rounded cylindrical walls, distinct upper rice rims and plausible contact on one shallow ivory plate. The continuous rim and broad front ceramic band improve construction and volume. The back-left/front-right arrangement and high oblique view remain clear.

Two warm rice rings, deep green nori and fresh green cucumber with darker peel remain distinct at66px and40px. The true32px cell preview retains a tiny two-center green/cream food cue rather than pretending to show a32px-wide dish. No unrelated food, garnish, prop, label or scene element was added.

Compared with the original, rounded rice highlights, brighter green cut faces and warm cream ceramic give a softer finish. Nori retains visible olive midtones and cylindrical volume without a broad black dead area; the rice stays warm and modeled. Plate reflections remain within the object, with no exterior glow or directional ground shadow.

Rounded rice groups and simple cucumber faces give edible detail without noisy photographic grains. Dense nori facets are visible in the enlarged source but resolve into coherent dark green walls at intended size. The ceramic well, uninterrupted rim and soft edge reflections remain subordinate to the recipe.

Standalone and preference compositions keep readable food/plate separation. The serving scene preserves the actual original placement and visibly discloses its existing customer-head occlusion; the separately labeled foreground-omitted view shows the full plate on the belt. At actual32px cell scale the16.5px food remains a green/cream two-roll cue with an ivory base. On light, gray and dark, required exports have clean integrated edges without a visible matte, exterior glow, detached fleck, cropped rim, hard seam or gap.
